notes: SR37 The Novogratz. thenovogratz.com 301-redirects to the brand's own direct-sell Wix Stores catalogue at www.shopthenovogratz.com (confirmed by prior Furniture-pass notes, re-verified this pass). robots.txt allows all crawlers with no Claude-specific disallow. Access: plain direct HTTP fetch (curl), no proxy/Playwright needed. Discovery: store-categories-sitemap.xml lists 24 category URLs including /category/best-sellers; the same URL is also present verbatim in the homepage's main nav links (confirmed live, not just sitemap). Opened https://www.shopthenovogratz.com/category/best-sellers directly: title 'Best Sellers | The Novogratz', a genuine Wix Stores category listing (16 distinct /product-page/ tiles server-rendered on first response, spanning furniture, lighting, rugs and wallpaper - a true cross-category merchandising listing, not a single-product page or editorial content). Qty taken from the page's own embedded wix-warmup-data JSON payload (same SSR data source used and cross-verified in the prior Home-Decor pass for this company): products_default_TPAMultiSection_mb2cc1z2_default.totalCount = 23. This is the site's own reported count, not an enumeration estimate (only 16 of the 23 products render in the unpaginated first-response HTML; the JSON totalCount field is the authoritative source per the site's own data layer). No other Best-Sellers-type URL found (checked footer, sitemap, and candidate slugs /category/top-sellers, /category/popular - all 404), so only one row is emitted.
